Concrete tool adapters call provider/service boundaries. The native loop consumes their tool contracts and execution receipts; provider-specific transport belongs to the adapter and service implementation.

Classes and extension points

Use the existing ownership boundaries when extending the code:

Responsibility Existing structure Extension approach
Native request services native/host.py: RuntimeHost composes the model client, registry, execution engine and optional services. NativeModelClient describes the transport contract. Inject a collaborator that satisfies the required contract; keep run progression in AgentLoop.
Desktop platform operations gateway_core/platform_desktop/protocol.py: DesktopAdapter describes capabilities, and NativeDesktop supplies shared behavior. Linux, macOS and Windows adapters inherit from it. Override platform-specific operations while preserving live identity checks and capability reporting.
Optional OCR gateway_core/ocr/protocol.py: OCRProvider describes availability and recognition. Implement the provider contract with bounded output and cancellation; callers must handle unavailable providers.
Source documentation manual/source_contracts.py: SourceContract reads, validates and exposes documentation to the audit and manual catalog. Keep parsing and validation shared so the two consumers interpret the same source consistently.
Error-source analysis error_catalog/audit.py: a private scanner owns one syntax tree, its indexes and ordered producer records. Extend a specific detection method behind the stable scan_python function.
Reserved model dispatch native/model_decision.py: _ModelDispatch holds the context and transport-readiness signal for one provider call. Revalidate model identity, saved context and cancellation before transport starts; keep call reservation in the acquisition flow.
SQLite schema initialization storage_connection.py: schema_transaction owns a writer reservation only when its caller has not already opened a transaction. Run DDL through execute_schema_script when it must share that transaction; leave existing commit/rollback ownership with the caller.

Paths beginning with gateway_core/, manual/ or error_catalog/ are relative to src/; the other paths in this table are relative to src/agent_runtime/. Stateless transformations can remain functions. A base class is useful when several implementations share a real contract and behavior; it is not required for every module.

Decision acquisition and acceptance

acquire_decision owns the generation and cancellation scopes. Its private acquisition flow consumes any eligible continuation, reserves bounded context, calls the provider, validates tool proposals and records canonical response content and usage. Named helpers keep preflight fallback, retry cleanup and continuation bookkeeping together. They do not start another execution loop or authorize a tool call.

_ModelDispatch is the callable submitted to the owned model worker. It carries the reserved working context, tools, continuation and measured model identity. At dispatch it checks whether current context or routing requires rebuilding the request, captures the evidence delivered to the model, and signals transport readiness only after stateful preparation finishes. That signal permits cancellation to abandon provider transport without abandoning unfinished state mutation.

prepare_dispatch appends the accepted assistant message and first delegates terminal responses to _prepare_terminal_response. Calls that remain then pass metadata validation, business-argument normalization and the existing Pause acceptance boundary. Effect claims remain downstream. Tests cover streaming, recovery, routing, cancellation and final-response preservation through these public flows.

Store initialization

Fresh follow-up and amendment tables include their current resource columns directly. Supported older tables still receive additive migrations. Follow-up schema inspection and changes share a SQLite writer reservation; task-timing triggers are replaced in one transaction so concurrent openers cannot interleave their removal and creation.

SQLite's executescript may commit an existing transaction. execute_schema_script instead submits complete statements individually, using SQLite's statement recognizer to retain trigger bodies and quoted semicolons. schema_transaction commits or rolls back only a transaction it opened. A caller that already owns a transaction retains that responsibility, including rollback after an error.

Do not split a route factory or registry just to reduce its span. For native initialization and dispatch, first follow the lease, the first saved claim and the physical execution boundary. A pure extraction needs before/after payload and side-effect evidence; moving transaction boundaries requires recovery tests. See the dead-path ledger before deleting compatibility, export or executable-entry modules.

Controller memory and recovery owners

The src/agent_runtime/runtime_state/ package documents its memory and recovery ownership contracts. Follow these boundaries when changing it:

Concern Source owner and invariant
Bootstrap and shutdown lifecycle.py acquires/binds ownership; bootstrap.py installs the complete repository graph; work.py counts admitted writers before shutdown can release ownership.
Publication hub.py freezes/stages values and validates optimistic read dependencies. Snapshot readers capture one published immutable root without joining writer locks. Retryable callbacks must stay free of external effects.
Repository shapes records.py maintains rows, grouped keys, indexes and sequences in one transaction. persistent.py and ordered.py share unchanged structure; ordered_nodes.py caches subtree rank and memory costs.
Memory diagnostics footprint.py estimates logical retention; size.py counts supported JSON payload bytes; memory_usage.py samples RSS off-path for observation only. The Controller has no application RAM budget or memory-based task gate. bootstrap_heap.py manages the shared startup GC capture.
Recovery checkpoint.py publishes complete generations by committing the manifest last. writer_budget.py paces serialization; managed_files.py retains referenced context/artifact bodies.
Permission and SQL boundaries security.py binds exact consent to arguments, targets and live policy scopes. sqlite_guard.py fences runtime SQL at open/prepare/cursor steps and grants context-local recovery access.
Process and offline ownership ownership.py holds path/inode OS fences; operator.py requires an inactive source and a fresh destination for offline copies. Existing operator CLI help remains unchanged.

Committed recovery files are immutable. The app retains one checkpoint and builds one temporary replacement using independent inodes. Publication verifies the replacement, switches the manifest, and retires the old save, legacy database inputs, and preserved repair copies. checkpoint_retention.py owns this rotation. A failed retirement blocks allocation of another replacement while durability remains visible.

Current subsystem ownership

Subsystem Ownership and relationship

Direct completion native/direct_completion.py separates terminal metadata from business arguments and verifies durable evidence.
Execution model configuration llm/model_configuration.py owns the catalog, presets and execution scope; llm/native_tool_client.py merges validated overrides; api/agent_ui_support/settings_runtime.py resolves new-run snapshots from existing discovery metadata.

Working Context and access native/conversation_working_context.py tracks verified reusable setup; context_read_policy.py controls projection/access.
Proxmox identity and authentication skills/proxmox/working_context.py publishes safe verified identity and checks profile/Gateway revisions. skills/proxmox/session.py reuses native/http_session_state.py and Gateway HTTP; native/conversation_resources.py releases run connections and sessions after committed conversation deletion/abandonment.
Typed Parameter Store profiles parameters/templates.py dispatches profile-specific validation, including literal HTTP version 3. parameters/store.py selects the hub-owned memory_store.py or standalone SQLite; references.py owns current accepted snapshots. See parameter storage and bindings.
Outbound Email skills/email/ resolves fixed sender revisions, approvals, MIME, attachments and delivery receipts. parameters/email_templates.py supplies SMTP OAuth presets. auth/broker.py owns tokens and exact consent continuation; skills/email/oauth_transport.py binds network exchanges to the selected Gateway. gateway_core/email_runtime.py, email_client.py, email_staging.py and oauth_transport.py own private dispatch, SMTP, volatile chunk staging and OAuth HTTPS.
Durable Memory skills/memory/ owns profile-wide JSON, metadata matching and proactive learning instructions; skills/memory/context.py pins a metadata snapshot before normal Agent decisions. Automatic mode defers recall until native/capability_selection.py binds the accepted selection. Tasks skip this workflow unless they include @use_memory.
Agent KV kv/store.py routes scratch storage to the Controller RAM owner in kv/memory_store.py or standalone SQLite; kv/lifecycle.py retires task scopes, and skills/kv/context.py binds explicit tools to accepted ownership. See the KV guide.
Artifacts and output artifacts/ owns generated file versions/access/retention; output_pipeline/ shapes real results for publication.
Verified execution cache execution_cache/ separates procedure identity, capture/safety, persistence and loop integration; cached knowledge does not prove fresh external state.
Progress and timing observability/agent_trace.py and native publication produce trace/activity facts; UI inspectors and execution diagrams render projections.
Desktop composition api/static/agent_ui/ owns workspace, settings, policy, Gateway Management, conversation navigation and inspector/diagram interactions.
Dedicated mobile composition api/static/agent_ui/mobile/ owns a separate composer/conversation/streaming page and lazy panels over shared APIs.
Conversation history activity api/agent_ui_support/conversation_activity.py projects existing run ownership; conversation_management.py supplies index/search metadata; desktop conversation_management.js and mobile lazy/history.js render selection and execution independently.
Browser automation skills/browser/ owns opt-in metadata and dispatch; gateway_core/browser/ owns lazy Playwright lifecycle, closed contracts, semantic revisions and file exports. Gateway routing, content policy and artifact collection retain shared ownership.
Screen observations skills/screen/ owns opt-in tools; gateway_core/screen_contract.py, screen_service.py, screen_worker.py, platform_screen/ and ocr/ own bounded explicit acquisition. Shared content policy excludes transient payloads.
Current clipboard skills/clipboard/ owns the opt-in skill; gateway_core/clipboard_contract.py, clipboard_service.py, clipboard_worker.py and platform_clipboard/ own bounded wire/native execution. observability/content_policy.py excludes payloads from diagnostic copies.
Desktop control skills/desktop/ owns the opt-in skill and receipt adapter; gateway_core/desktop_contract.py, desktop_service.py and platform_desktop/ own structured wire validation, cancellation and native host operations.
Gateway core and wrappers gateway_core/ owns shared target execution; gateway_agent/, gateway_macos/, gateway_windows/ supply platform configuration and lifecycle.
Resource lifecycle and recovery gateway_core/jobs.py owns admission, observation CAS and baseline persistence; resource_claims.py versions effect/ownership facts; resource_descriptors.py derives target resources using shared execution/resources.py overlap. resource_execution.py closes foreground supervision; native/resource_recovery.py owns saved candidate continuation, bounded wait watches and UI decisions. The existing resource reconciliation route serializes baseline, stop and explicit candidate-scoped risk decisions.
Manual and source reference manual/source_contracts.py defines Tier A/B inventory; source_catalog.py renders contracts/relationships; documentation_audit.py verifies coverage.
Diagnostic console agent_runtime/console/ serves process/resource diagnostics; startup.sh supplies the Agent target PID.
Independent public website smto_site/app.py serves public product/docs/download pages on 8017. content.py enforces explicit publication; releases.py validates local metadata. It owns no runtime state or credentials and never calls a Gateway or model. See docs/smto-site.md.
Identity agent_runtime/branding.py resolves presentation metadata while compatibility interfaces retain legacy identifiers.

For native/, kv/, skills/, capabilities/ and similar package paths above, the base is src/agent_runtime/; Gateway and manual packages are directly under src/. Use the served exhaustive source catalog for all maintained files and source relationships for static imports and explicit collaborator contracts. Static edges are not a call graph.
